121488164.description: Adegramotide is an experimental drug intended for treatment of various hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including glioblastoma multiforme.

121492004.name: Inotersen
121492004.description: Inotersen, sold under the brand name Tegsedi, is a 2'-O- antisense oligonucleotide medication used for the treatment of nerve damage in adults with hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis.

135537060.name: Rintatolimod
135537060.description: Rintatolimod, sold under the tradename Ampligen, is a medication intended for treatment of myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome .

138691364.name: AH-494
138691364.description: AH-494 is a potent and selective, water-soluble full agonist at the 5-HT7 serotonin receptor of the imidazolylindole family.

141803940.name: NBoc-DMT
141803940.description: NBoc-DMT, or NB-DMT, also known as N1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonergic psychedelic of the tryptamine family.

146187940.name: Pyraquinate

149605668.name: Xenon tetrachloride
149605668.description: Xenon tetrachloride is an unstable inorganic compound with the chemical formula XeCl4.

155884836.name: Trifluoromescaline
155884836.description: Trifluoromescaline , also known as 4- -3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a derivative of the phenethylamine psychedelic mescaline, which has a 4-trifluoromethoxy group replacing the 4-methoxy group of...

158619172.name: Potassium pentasulfide
158619172.description: Potassium pentasulfide is the inorganic compound with the formula K2S5.

160074276.name: Cerium diiodide
160074276.description: Cerium diiodide is an iodide of cerium, with the chemical formula of CeI2.

162533924.name: Ensitrelvir
162533924.description: Ensitrelvir, sold under the brand name Xocova, is an antiviral medication used as a treatment for COVID-19 and as post-exposure prophylaxis to prevent COVID-19 infections following exposure.

163192484.name: DOPF
163192484.description: DOPF, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-4- amphetamine, is a designer drug from the amphetamine and DOx families.

165365668.name: Cadmium(I) tetrachloroaluminate
165365668.description: Cadmium tetrachloroaluminate is the inorganic compound with the formula Cd2[AlCl4]2, a tetrachloroaluminate of cadmium .

166116644.name: 5-TFMO-DMT
166116644.description: 5-TFMO-DMT (5- -DMT, 5-OCF3-DMT, 5- -N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative related to drugs such as 5-MeO-DMT and DMT .

170763684.name: 1cP-MiPLA
170763684.description: 1cP-MiPLA, also known as 1-cyclopropanoyl-MiPLA or 1-cyclopropanoyl-N-methyl-N-isopropyllysergamide, is a presumed psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family.

381609252.name: Envafolimab
381609252.description: Envafolimab is an anti-PD-L1 nanobody used in cancer immunotherapy.

900000036.name: 2CD-2,5-DiEtO
900000036.description: 2CD-2,5-DiEtO, also known as 2,5-diethoxy-4-methylphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to the psychedelic drug 2C-D.

900000164.name: Ammonium tetrathiovanadate
900000164.description: Ammonium tetrathiovanadate is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula 3VS4. It is a violet solid. The compound is a salt consisting of three ammonium cations and a tetrahedral VS43- anion.

900000292.name: Biscaline
900000292.description: Biscaline, also known as 3,5-dimethoxy-4-phenylphenethylamine, is a monoamine receptor modulator of the phenethylamine and desoxyscaline families.

900000932.name: Hepatitis A and typhoid vaccine
900000932.description: Hepatitis A and typhoid vaccine is a combination vaccine to protect against the infectious diseases hepatitis A and typhoid.

900001060.name: JK-05
900001060.description: JK-05 is a broad-spectrum antiviral drug developed by the Chinese company Sihuan Pharmaceutical along with the Chinese Academy of Military Medical Sciences.

900001188.name: Lutetium vanadate
900001188.description: Lutetium vanadate is inorganic compound with ferromagnetic and semiconducting properties, with the chemical formula of Lu2V2O7 with the same structure as pyrochlore.

900001444.name: Oxelumab
900001444.description: Oxelumab is a human monoclonal antibody targeting OX40L designed for the treatment of asthma. Oxelumab was developed by Genentech and co-developed by Roche.

900001572.name: Plutonium oxyiodide
900001572.description: Plutonium oxyiodide or plutonium oxide iodide is an inorganic compound of plutonium, oxygen, and iodine with the chemical formula PuOI.

900001700.name: Praseodymium orthoscandate
900001700.description: Praseodymium orthoscandate is a chemical compound, a rare-earth oxide with a perovskite structure. It has the chemical formula of PrScO3.

900002084.name: Triuranium heptoxide
900002084.description: Triuranium heptoxide is an inorganic compound of uranium and oxygen with the chemical formula U3O7.

900002212.name: Zolbetuximab
900002212.description: Zolbetuximab, sold under the brand name Vyloy, is a monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of gastric cancer.
